name: health

folders.02 Chronicle/Results: Test and lab results, filed as `YYYY-MM-DD <Type> <Detail>`.
folders.02 Chronicle/Visits: Visit notes and summaries, filed by date of visit.
folders.06 Reference/Conditions: One note per ongoing condition: what it is, how it presents here, what is being done.
folders.06 Reference/Raw Archive: Untouched originals exactly as received. Never edit anything in here.
folders.06 Reference/Raw Archive/Snapshots: Dated zip snapshots of the project.

conservatism_notes.conservative: Default to watchful waiting. Name the invasive option and its evidence, but lead with the least-invasive path and say plainly what would have to change to justify escalating.
conservatism_notes.balanced: Present invasive and non-invasive paths with equal weight and comparable depth. Do not lean.
conservatism_notes.interventionist: Where guidelines support intervention, say so directly and early. Still give the conservative case, but do not bury the interventional option.

question_list_intro: Living list. Keep the Urgent / Next visit / Settled split.
